location_exception_reason: Toilet cubicles are standardised modular partition systems; buyer choice is driven by material (HPL, SS, FRP), configuration (floor-mounted, ceiling-hung), and specifications (thickness, hardware grade), not geographic origin. Location in title adds no product intelligence.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer') in toilet cubicle titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'HPL Toilet Cubicle Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title. The product is a cubicle system regardless of seller classification.
